verdict.rationale: Alloy documents transaction-monitoring workflows that generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met. Its API reference also points to an Investigations construct that replaces deprecated endpoints, so investigations exist as a product capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows an analyst prioritizing alerts or manually grouping related subjects and transactions into an investigation. Missing for 10: alert prioritization/triage, grouping multiple subjects and transactions into one investigation, analyst-facing investigation workflow docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
These endpoints are deprecated in favor of using Investigations.
